web_blocks.title: Executive Thesis: COMPOUNDER_PASS Business vs. Breached $348.00 Stop & Stage 4 Tape

web_blocks.html: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (NYSE: TSM) keeps a price-blind COMPOUNDER_PASS rating (`kpi_health: PASS_WITH_WATCH`) after Q3 2026 Form 6-K and November 10 filings [21, 22, 23]. October 2026 revenue surged 59.7% YoY to NT$586.89B, while Q3 net sales hit NT$1,494.24B (U.S. clients 78.87%, packaging +112.8% YoY) [21, 22]. Gross net cash rose from ~$66B at year-end 2025 to $93.64B (~$82.3B ex-NT$359.48B refundable customer temporary receipts), while 9M CFO/NI eased to 117.6% [21]. Key watch items include $40.93B in capex approvals, $1.5B in AI equity stakes, NT$167.59B in PP&E grant deductions flattering depreciation and ROIC, Q2's NT$63.20B non-cash VIS gain, and 25% Section 232 tariffs [1, 21, 23].

Yet the stock broke our locked structural stop on November 20, 2026. TSM fell 9.48% to close at $318.71 ($319.14 on TradingView) on 37.17M shares, or 2.38x average volume [28, 35]. That drop shattered our $348.00 stop inside a US Downtrend (38.8% > 50-DMA, 10 distribution days) [35]. While `facts_US_2026-11-20.json` tags `Stage 1` at the $318.48 63-day low, `snapshots_US_2026-11-20.json` flags STAGE_4 / CAP_REJECTED [28, 35]. Price sits 24.5% below its falling 50D SMA ($422.15) and 21.0% below its 200D SMA ($403.56), with 4H RSI at 22.47 [28]. Existing Schwab shares (2.3344 shares, $744.00 MV, 0.99% NAV, -$255.96 loss) require EXIT_IMMEDIATELY into 100% CASH. New capital rates REJECTED (`TIER_0`, `TREND`).

web_blocks.title: Single Hinge Claim, Catalyst Calendar & Re-Entry Rules

web_blocks.html: Single Hinge Claim: TSMC's intrinsic compounding rests on sustaining >20%–25% AI/HPC growth and >64% gross margins through 2027 without a hyperscaler capex pause as annual capex reaches $60B–$64B [4, 5]. Test that claim via Q4 2026 earnings (mid-January 2027) [32], monthly revenue prints, and fab utilization (>75%). Meanwhile, macro rates (US10Y 5.04% [34]) and S&P 500 breadth (38.8% > 50-DMA, 10 distribution days [35]) dictate tape risk.

Chapters 1–6 deliver TSMC's price-blind `COMPOUNDER_PASS` foundation, newly patched with Q3 2026 Form 6-K footnote forensics, $1.5B AI equity investments, and Section 232 tariff disclosures [1, 21, 23]. Chapters 7–9 then apply the November 20, 2026 market tape ($318.71), Reverse DCF ($1,561.80B EV), live peer comps (UMC, INTC, ASX, NVDA, TXN, MSFT), Stage 4 multi-timeframe breakdown, and our `EXIT_IMMEDIATELY` / `REJECTED` execution plan [28, 29, 33].

Bottom line for execution: sell all 2.3344 Schwab shares of TSM at market (~$744.00 proceeds) because $318.71 breached the locked $348.00 structural stop, and park 100% in Cash. Hold zero shares and zero options until TSM builds a multi-week Stage 1 base above $266.82–$318.48 and reclaims the 200-day ($403.56) and 30-week ($417.72) averages on strong volume.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to the November 20, 2026 refreshed monograph on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (NYSE: TSM). Even the finest industrial monopoly on Earth must obey portfolio risk rules when its stock breaks structural support.

Blind to share price, TSMC earns COMPOUNDER_PASS with a PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI check after auditing Q3 2026 filings and October's 59.7% revenue surge. Gross net cash climbed from ~$66 billion at year-end 2025 to $93.64 billion (~$82.3 billion excluding NT$359.48 billion in customer temporary receipts), while 9M CFO conversion stood at 117.6% alongside NT$167.59 billion in grant offsets, a NT$63.20 billion VIS gain, and $1.5 billion in AI equity stakes. Yet on November 20, TSM plunged 9.48% to $318.71 on 2.38x volume, shattering our locked $348.00 stop inside a formal US Downtrend. Although our market-facts ledger mechanically tags Stage 1 at the $318.48 63-day low, our TradingView snapshot confirms Stage 4 (-24.5% below a falling 50-day SMA and -21.0% below the 200-day SMA).

Therefore, we execute EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 2.3344 Schwab shares (~$744.00 proceeds), park 100% in Cash, and assign REJECTED (TIER_0) to new capital until a Stage 1 base and Stage 2 reclaim above $403.56–$417.72 form.

book_subsections.title: At-a-Glance: Stop Breached & Capital Preserved
paragraphs: For our existing Schwab position of 2.3344 shares ($744.00 market value, $999.96 cost basis, 0.99% weight), closing at $318.71 violated our $348.00 hard stop. Our upward-only stop ratchet rule prohibits lowering a stop on a falling stock, requiring EXIT_IMMEDIATELY into 100% Cash.

For new capital, Stage 4 technicals (CAP_REJECTED) and a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend require a REJECTED (TIER_0) verdict despite a 13.81x forward P/E. We stay sidelined until TSM builds a durable base and reclaims $403.56–$417.72.

book_subsections.title: What Changed Between November 13 and November 20, 2026
paragraphs: One week ago, TSM traded at $398.73, clinging just 1% below its 200-day moving average with a $348.00 hard stop protecting our 2.3344 shares. Between November 13 and November 20, our Pass 1 audit confirmed TSMC's operational dominance ($93.64B gross net cash, ~$82.3B ex-deposits, 117.6% 9M CFO/NI) while flagging critical footnotes: NT$359.48 billion in customer temporary receipts, NT$167.59 billion in cash grants lowering GAAP depreciation, a NT$63.20 billion non-cash VIS gain, $1.5 billion in AI equity approvals, and Section 232 25% tariff risks.

Over that same week, the S&P 500 slipped from Correction into a formal Downtrend, and TSM plunged 20.07% to $318.71. That selloff compressed forward P/E from 17.26x to 13.81x, yet broke $348.00 decisively—turning WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT and HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP into REJECTED and EXIT_IMMEDIATELY.

book_subsections.title: What to Watch Next in 2027
paragraphs: Track three signposts while sitting in cash: Q4 2026 earnings in mid-January 2027 for gross margin (>64%) and FY2027 capex guidance; stabilization above $266.82–$318.48 with shrinking down-day volume; and a broader S&P 500 shift out of Downtrend.
Only when all three align will we re-underwrite TSMC for a fresh Stage 2 campaign.
